prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: a small reusable feature-number medallion for an illuminated medieval manuscript journal UI.
Create ONE flat hand-painted heraldic medallion on a genuinely transparent background. Center it on a square canvas and fill about 85% of the canvas. Deep indigo oval-round central field, completely blank and untextured for a live ivory numeral to be added later. Thin double antique-gold outlines with tiny pointed lobes at the four cardinal points, and a restrained gold foliate/interlace rim inspired by Book of Kells and medieval royal fieldbooks. Overall silhouette slightly taller than wide, about 4:5. Match oxblood/gold manuscript page corners, but keep this medallion predominantly indigo and antique gold. Crisp dark ink outlines, subtle worn gouache pigment on the narrow gold border, sober and elegant. The central blank indigo field occupies at least 65% of the width and height. The outline must read at 48 pixels tall. No text, numbers, letters, symbols in the middle, jewelry, bevel, drop shadow, glow, background, parchment, page, or surrounding objects. One single isolated ornament, flat straight-on view.
processing: Resize to 192 pixels wide with cwebp; encode at quality 90 and alpha quality 100. Keep numerals as live CSS counter text.
